Messages.Author: Shankar Gupta
Messages.Body:
If a Black Hand Vampire diablarizes, playing the Art of Memory, and the
Bloodhunt is cancelled by Ebony Fox Hunt, can the Ebony Fox Hunt be moved
back to your hand with the Art of Memory?

~Shankar Gupta

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
In message <DsByb.175885$Gq.21...@twister.nyc.rr.com>,
"Shankar Gupta" <shanka...@hotmail.com> mumbled something about:

>If a Black Hand Vampire diablarizes, playing the Art of Memory, and the
>Bloodhunt is cancelled by Ebony Fox Hunt, can the Ebony Fox Hunt be moved
>back to your hand with the Art of Memory?

"The Art of Memory: Action Modifier.
Requires a Black Hand vampire. Only usable when the action is announced.
Remove this card from the game when it is played. If the action is
successful, move one card played by this vampire during this action from
your ash heap to your hand. Discard down to your hand size."

Ebony Fox Hunt is a Master Out-Of-Turn; it is not played by vampires.

-- Derek

Messages.Author: Fredrik Appelberg
Messages.Body:

No, since Art of Memory can only move a "card played by this vampire".
Ebony Fox Hunt is a master card and is not played by the vampire itself.

Cheers,

Messages.Author: Oortje4ever
Messages.Body:
Fredrik Appelberg <fre...@mulli.nu> wrote in message news:<bqertj$21ru9o$1...@ID-183559.news.uni-berlin.de>...

> Shankar Gupta wrote:
> > If a Black Hand Vampire diablarizes, playing the Art of Memory, and the
> > Bloodhunt is cancelled by Ebony Fox Hunt, can the Ebony Fox Hunt be moved
> > back to your hand with the Art of Memory?

2 nd point why it is impossible: blood hunt is called after an action
has completely resolved. So no action modifiers are playable during a
bloodhunt.
as far as I can recall no reactions are playable either during the
bloodhunt.
but as always i might be totaly wrong.

ps the reform body can only be played after the Bloodhunt.

Oortje

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Oortje4ever wrote:
> 2 nd point why it is impossible: blood hunt is called after an action
> has completely resolved. So no action modifiers are playable during a
> bloodhunt.

No. The bloodhunt referendum is conducted during but independent of
the current action. That (the "independent of" part) is the reason
that no action modifiers can be played.

> as far as I can recall no reactions are playable either during the
> bloodhunt.

Correct, for the same reason as above.

> ps the reform body can only be played after the Bloodhunt.

Reform Body can be played by the victim of diablerie prior to
the bloodhunt refendum (which is then, of course, not called).

Reform Body cannot be played by a vampire against whom a
bloodhunt is called.
